name: Account sync
description: Apps' account-scoped tables (powos-app.json "sync") on every device of the owner: rows go up to and come down from the account store on PowStation (the realm's /v1/account/rows, this device's own realm token), last writer wins per row (lib/apps/powos-account-sync; docs/REMOTE-POWOS.md section 2.5). Idle until the device has joined. Outbound only, no port. Unit: units/phone/powos-account-sync.json.
